problems.probabilistic_scope: The diagonal matrix is a support point, not itself a Wigner ensemble. Strict inequalities persist on an open neighborhood; the valid real Gaussian ensemble assigns positive probability to it. No claimed lower probability scale or counterexample to the final theorem.

independent_acceptance.performing_role: Primary assistant in the assigned acceptance Chat; independent of original initial-review conversation
independent_acceptance.source_claim_and_location: Section6.4 after(6.19), printed215/PDF55, continuing to216/PDF56. The source sets E=gamma_k+u(c_k-1)delta and asserts an implication from lambda_k-gamma_k>u c_k delta to a centered smoothed trace exceeding(1-epsilon)u sqrt(2)/pi sqrt(log N).
independent_acceptance.hypotheses_and_quantifiers: Definition1.1(PDF3-4) permits real GOE variances 1/N off diagonal and2/N on diagonal. The quantile is F(gamma_j)=(j-1/2)/N(PDF5); Theorem1.8(ii)(PDF6) allows compact bulk, k=(N+1)/2, kappa=1/4, A=1, u=4, epsilon=1/4 and arbitrarily large odd N. The threshold remains in the compact bulk. Smoothing has nonnegative unit mass on[0,1], width delta=sqrt(log N)/N, and the upper cutoff is irrelevant below2.5.
independent_acceptance.decisive_independent_check: At gamma_k=0 and c_k=sqrt(2), set lambda_j=gamma_j for j<k and gamma_j+(4sqrt(2)+1)delta otherwise. Then lambda_k>E+delta by4delta and every lower eigenvalue is below E, so sum f_E(lambda_j)=(N+1)/2 for every allowed smoothing density. Since rho<=1/pi, centered trace<=1/2+(4sqrt(2)-3)sqrt(log N)/pi, strictly less than the claimed3sqrt(2)sqrt(log N)/pi once N is large. The gap is(3-sqrt(2))sqrt(log N)/pi-1/2>0.
independent_acceptance.counterevidence_and_boundaries: GOE has positive density on all real symmetric matrices. Strict margins and continuity give a violating open neighborhood of the diagonal support point with positive probability for each large odd N. The point is not itself mislabeled as an ensemble. The O(sqrt(log N)/N) displacement is inside ordinary rigidity(2.9), since phi/sqrt(log N) tends to infinity. No useful lower bound on the probability scale of that neighborhood or counterexample to the final tail theorem is claimed.
independent_acceptance.severity_result: Major retained: this is a false leading-order deterministic inference in the conversion of(6.19) to the sharp Gaussian Markov exponent of Theorem1.8(ii), even if a short local correction is possible. It does not establish failure of Theorem1.8(i), the maximum results or the whole paper.
independent_acceptance.repair_check: With E*=gamma_k+(u c_k-1)delta the antecedent forces at least N-k+1 eigenvalues above the full smoothing transition. The exact centered lower bound is1/2+N(F(E*)-F(gamma_k)). Bulk Taylor expansion gives(u sqrt(2)/pi-rho(gamma_k)+o(1))sqrt(log N), uniformly for u<=A sqrt(log N). This repairs the local large-u coefficient after a parameter-dependent lower threshold; the bounded-u split, exceptional cutoff event and moment optimization remain unverified as a complete proof.
